observation.visible_scene: Interior of a clear blender jar seen from the side: a metal blade assembly sits at the bottom center, a molded handle is fixed on the left, and the bright back wall carries horizontal measurement marks plus scattered colored splatters. Two larger rounded objects—a green one and a yellow one—hover in the air on the right side of the jar, along with a few small flying fragments.
visible_changes: The bottom blades change orientation from frame to frame, indicating continuous rotation throughout the excerpt.
The green object remains in the upper-right area, drifting slightly and rotating; a pale 'S' marking on its surface becomes visible in the later frames.
The yellow object stays in the mid-right area, tumbling so its look alternates between a bright-yellow rounded face and a pale/whitish flat face, with small shifts in position.
A few small yellow/green bits appear near the left wall and move relative to the fixed splatters, while most wall splatters stay put.
The handle, jar outline, and wall markings do not move, consistent with a static camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: The blender was already running before frame 1 and continues after frame 41; the cause of the objects being airborne and any later outcome (e.g., whether they are pulverized) are not shown in this segment.
uncertain_details: Whether some wall splatters actually move or only appear to due to lighting/focus.
The exact number and identity of the small flying fragments.
The precise vertical drift of the green object between frames.
